    im = Image.open(path)

    for y in range(h):

            pts = []

from PIL import Image

def find_dark_blobs(path, thresh=60):
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    px = im.load()
    mask = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r,g,b = px[x,y][:3]
            if r < thresh and g < thresh and b < thresh:
                mask[y][x] = True
    visited = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    blobs = []
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if not mask[y][x] or visited[y][x]:
                continue
            # flood
            stack = [(x,y)]
            visited[y][x] = True
            pts = []
            while stack:
                cx,cy = stack.pop()
                pts.append((cx,cy))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny = cx+dx, cy+dy
                    if 0<=nx<w and 0<=ny<h and mask[ny][nx] and not visited[ny][nx]:
                        visited[ny][nx] = True
                        stack.append((nx,ny))
            if 20 < len(pts) < 5000:
                sx = sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts)
                sy = sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
                minx=min(p[0] for p in pts); maxx=max(p[0] for p in pts)
                miny=min(p[1] for p in pts); maxy=max(p[1] for p in pts)
                blobs.append((len(pts), sx, sy, maxx-minx, maxy-miny))

import workcell

def blobs(path, thresh=80):
    from PIL import Image
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    px = im.load()
    mask = bytearray(w*h)
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r,g,b = px[x,y][:3]
            if r < thresh and g < thresh and b < thresh:
                mask[y*w+x] = 1
    visited = bytearray(w*h)
    blobs = []
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            i = y*w+x
            if not mask[i] or visited[i]:
                continue
            stack = [(x,y)]
            visited[i] = 1
            pts = []
            minx=maxx=x; miny=maxy=y
            while stack:
                cx,cy = stack.pop()
                pts.append((cx,cy))
                if cx<minx: minx=cx
                if cx>maxx: maxx=cx
                if cy<miny: miny=cy
                if cy>maxy: maxy=cy
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny = cx+dx, cy+dy
                    if 0<=nx<w and 0<=ny<h:
                        j = ny*w+nx
                        if mask[j] and not visited[j]:

                            stack.append((nx,ny))

            if 15 < n < 8000:
                sx = sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n

                blobs.append((n, round(sx,1), round(sy,1), maxx-minx+1, maxy-miny+1))
    blobs.sort(reverse=True)

def white_blobs(path, thresh=180):
    im = Image.open(path)
    w,h = im.size
    px = im.load()
    mask = bytearray(w*h)
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r,g,b = px[x,y][:3]
            if r>=thresh and g>=thresh and b>=thresh:
                mask[y*w+x]=1
    visited = bytearray(w*h)
    blobs=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            i=y*w+x
            if not mask[i] or visited[i]:
                continue
            stack=[(x,y)]
            visited[i]=1
            pts=[]
            minx=maxx=x; miny=maxy=y
            while stack:
                cx,cy=stack.pop()
                pts.append((cx,cy))
                if cx<minx: minx=cx
                if cx>maxx: maxx=cx
                if cy<miny: miny=cy
                if cy>maxy: maxy=cy
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                    if 0<=nx<w and 0<=ny<h:
                        j=ny*w+nx
                        if mask[j] and not visited[j]:
                            visited[j]=1
                            stack.append((nx,ny))
            n=len(pts)
            if n>=20:
                sx=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n
                sy=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/n
                blobs.append((n,sx,sy,maxx-minx+1,maxy-miny+1))
    blobs.sort(reverse=True)
    return blobs
